sources.title: phi4-mini
sources.snippet: Readme Note: this model requires Ollama 0.5.13 or later. Phi-4-mini-instruct is a lightweight open model built upon synthetic data and filtered publicly available websites - with a focus on high-quality, reasoning dense data. The model belongs to the Phi-4 model family and supports 128K token context length.
